name: Project foundation
description: Cross-project truth, change, migration, and verification contracts.

invariants.title: One source of truth per project fact
invariants.statement: Every mutable project fact has one authoritative owner; caches, recovery copies, generated output, and remote mirrors do not become parallel writable truth.
preflight: Name the authoritative owner before changing storage or state.
List every producer and consumer that must migrate.
evidence: The formal producer writes the authoritative boundary.
The formal consumer reads the same result.
A restart or second consumer does not recover from an older mirror.

invariants.title: Migrate the contract, not one symptom
invariants.statement: A replacement type, command, state boundary, or helper is complete only after every caller and consumer uses it and the superseded path is inactive.
preflight: Inventory callers, exports, persisted fields, recovery paths, tests, and documentation.
Define the residual search that proves the old identity exited.
evidence: The new path preserves required behavior.
Activity searches contain no superseded public entry or fallback.
Any external compatibility adapter has an explicit owner and exit condition.

invariants.title: Verify the chain a user actually depends on
invariants.statement: Core verification starts with the formal producer, crosses the real storage, transport, or native boundary, reaches the formal consumer, and ends in an observable result.
preflight: State which boundary the test is intended to prove.
evidence: The producer created the tested result.
The consumer did not receive hand-written replacement data.
The user-visible result is inspected or exercised.

invariants.title: A project does not require Git
invariants.statement: A normal directory remains a valid project; Git is detected only at the exact project root and is used for history or publication when present.
preflight: Inspect the exact project root before invoking Git.
Keep project facts and Git facts separate.
evidence: A directory inside a parent repository is not treated as its own Git project.
A plain temporary directory can be inspected, adopted, and verified.

invariants.title: Diagnostic output is classified by evidence
invariants.statement: Build, linker, development-server, runtime, and application messages are classified by their producing phase, command outcome, observable chain impact, and reproducibility rather than by a warning label or color alone.
preflight: Identify which process and phase produced each material message.
Separate command success, process liveness, artifact generation, and user-visible behavior.
evidence: A warning is either explained with its actual impact, assigned an owner and action, or kept as a bounded observation.
A successful command is not used to dismiss a reproducible message that changes the formal artifact or user result.
One process's output is not attributed to another layer without evidence.

checks.message: Project files must remain the authoritative project truth.
The adopted project profile must be present.

manual_verification.title: Primary user result
steps: Choose the project's first observable user result.
Exercise it through the formal entry point.
Confirm the result is produced, crosses its real boundary, and is consumed.

manual_verification.title: Superseded path audit
steps: Search active source, tests, configuration, public exports, and documentation for superseded identities.
Confirm retained compatibility is external, intentional, and time-bounded.

manual_verification.title: Build and runtime diagnostic triage
steps: For each material diagnostic, record its producer, phase, complete context, exit state, and reproducibility.
Confirm whether the formal artifact and user result changed before deciding to explain, monitor, or remediate it.
